name: Till
source:
A quiet boy after a car accident.
He was known by being a problematic student with a harsh attitude with his friend Ivan.
Till lives alone after her mother´s death and lives with a big monster in an apartment.
After the accident he wasnt only more quiet, but also oblivious of his surroundings.
